propositions: Project-supplied code-review criteria have applies_to stored but never validated at overlay load or read during dispatch, causing them to run on every review regardless of changed files
The dispatch path filters project criteria only on criterion_id prefix and exec type, never examining applies_to or changed_files, bypassing the workflow's membership gating
_validate_routing_entry does not check applies_to shape (list of strings), silently ignoring malformed values instead of raising errors
Plan-review project criteria ARE gated on applies_at (the equivalent field) with full validation and dispatch filtering, creating an asymmetry with code-review
Globs must be resolved from effective_routing(repo_root) rather than packaged routing_index(), and matched against the same changed_files list used by the triggers step
Project criteria with empty or absent applies_to must remain always-on, while non-empty applies_to must gate dispatch to reviews affecting matching files
